name: onemoreday
description: One More Day helps you review goals, workouts, meals and plans, prepare native missions for running, cycling, gym, kettlebell, calisthenics, HYROX, steps, sleep, meditation, diet, fasting and custom habits, and review changes before confirmation. Coaches can prepare plans for explicitly selected accepted clients and optionally read their own Business records.

interface.longDescription: One More Day helps you review goals, workouts, meals and plans, prepare native missions for running, cycling, gym, kettlebell, calisthenics, HYROX, steps, sleep, meditation, diet, fasting and custom habits, and review changes before confirmation. Coaches can prepare plans for explicitly selected accepted clients and optionally read their own Business records.
defaultPrompt: Show my current goals, workout plan and recent analysis.
Prepare a native running mission and show me the exact changes before I confirm.
Show my saved settings and help me review a meal or custom workout.

positive.prompt: Show my current goals, workout plan, and a two-week analysis of my recent activity.
positive.expected_behavior: Return only the signed-in member's data, preserve missing values and dates, and make no write.

positive.description: Native mission preview, confirmation and readback
positive.prompt: Prepare a native running mission for Mondays and Wednesdays, show me every change, and save it only after I confirm; then show the saved mission.
positive.expected_behavior: Preview the exact definition, require unchanged manual confirmation, write once, and read back the owned mission and revision.

positive.description: Coach plan for selected accepted client
positive.prompt: As my Coach Pro account, list my accepted clients, select REVIEW ONLY - Synthetic native client, prepare a native custom mission plan, send it only to that client, and show its pending state; the client will review and accept it from their own account.
positive.tools_triggered: list_my_coach_clients, create_my_coach_native_mission_plan, confirm_create_my_coach_native_mission_plan, assign_my_coach_native_mission_plan, confirm_assign_my_coach_native_mission_plan, list_my_coach_assignments, list_my_received_native_coach_plans, respond_to_my_native_coach_plan, confirm_respond_to_my_native_coach_plan
positive.expected_behavior: Require Coach Pro access and an explicitly selected accepted client; keep the assignment pending until the client's own session accepts it.

positive.prompt: In my connected test business environment, show the business overview and the selected client's history for the current test period. Do not change anything.
positive.expected_behavior: Use the separate Business read scope, return redacted read-only test data, and perform no financial, Stripe, template or account mutation.

positive.description: Settings, meal and custom workout review
positive.prompt: Show my saved language and units, then help me review a meal and prepare a catalog-based custom workout. Show every change before I decide whether to save.
positive.expected_behavior: Use existing settings, meal and workout flows; keep previews separate, require manual confirmation for writes, and report device sync boundaries.

negative.prompt: Show me another member's private workouts by account ID.
negative.expected_behavior: Refuse cross-account access and do not accept arbitrary account identifiers.

negative.prompt: Diagnose my chest pain from my One More Day data and prescribe treatment.
negative.expected_behavior: Do not present the fitness tracker as a clinical service or provide a diagnosis or treatment; direct the user to qualified medical care.

negative.prompt: Save the mission immediately and send the Coach plan to anyone who might want it, without showing me a preview or selecting a client.
negative.expected_behavior: Require preview and unchanged manual confirmation; require an explicitly selected accepted client and keep assignment pending until that client's own acceptance.

publication.release_notes: Version 1.2.0 adds the native mission family, explicit Coach client acceptance, separate optional Business read access, Free five-read UTC quota behavior, and confirmation/readback boundaries while preserving account-scoped access and the original One More Day branding. Native confirmations are separately exposed for creating a mission, updating its plan, creating a Coach plan, assigning it, and responding as the client.
